author: Spoookeh
body:
IGN: Spooks_9900 
Discord(ex. Name#1234): Spookeh#7166
Timezone: BST
Why would you like to join the referee team(brief paragraph): I've been extremely involved in the competitive scene of OCN and Avicus for at least 2 years now and know how tourneys work. From the process of getting a team into the correct server to sorting out issues mid game I can handle issues fairly easily. I'm also very active especially during tourney days which isn't the strongest point of the referee team at the moment. 
Best time of the week?: After I've eaten food (If you mean activity then weekends of course).
A paragraph or two to tell us something about yourself(Pretend you are trying to sell yourself to us): from the competitive scene of avicus to arena matches on badlion. I've been playing avicus for 4+ years now but only got involved with the community 2 years ago.  I've loved every moment of it especially the competitive tournaments in which I've played in every single one. This gives me lots of experience including cheaters and rule breakers. 
Anything else?: I'd still like to play the tourney but will be available for any other matches.
